::: {#exm-union-cancel}
#### A union does not cancel

Claim to disprove: for all sets $A$, $B$ and $C$,
if $A \cup B = A \cup C$, then $B = C$.

Let $A = \set{1}$, $B = \set{1}$ and $C = \emptyset$.
Then $A \cup B = \set{1}$ and $A \cup C = \set{1}$, so $A \cup B = A \cup C$,
but $B \ne C$.
So the claim is false.

:::
